description: Two-sided marketplace with listings, search, user roles (buyer/seller), reviews, and payment integration.

dataModels: Listing { id, title, description, price, images, sellerId, category, status }
Review { id, listingId, buyerId, rating, comment }
Order { id, listingId, buyerId, status, total }
integrations: Image upload (S3, Cloudflare R2, or Uploadthing)
architectureNotes: ListingGrid renders a responsive grid of ListingCards with search and category filters.
SearchFilters provides category dropdown, price range slider, sort order, and text search.
ReviewCard displays star rating, reviewer info, and comment with timestamp.
Seller dashboard shows active listings, orders, and revenue metrics.
Buyer dashboard shows purchase history, saved listings, and pending reviews.
Wire Stripe Connect for split payments between platform and sellers.
